meta.name: La chispa del amor
meta.description: Cuando un heredero con un corazón artificial conoce a una mujer —literalmente— eléctrica, hacen un trato que hará latir su corazón en más de un sentido.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Na Bo-bae is a struggling writer — and human electrical conductor. Suddenly, she bumps into Baek Ho-rang, the first person who's immune to her sparks.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: When Ho-rang realizes that Bo-bae's strange powers could be the solution to his heart-battery needs, he tries to make her an offer she can't refuse.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Ho-rang and Bo-bae become roommates and make things official. As per their contract, they go on their first date for Bo-bae's romance research.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: Bo-bae ends up as Ho-rang's personal assistant. After a tense birthday lunch with his family, Ho-rang is moved by Bo-bae's simple surprise.

videos.title: Episodio 5
videos.overview: Han Seol-hee comes to Ho-rang with a marriage proposal, but he makes his disinterest clear. Meanwhile, Ji Eun-ho tries to draw closer to Bo-bae.

videos.title: Episodio 6
videos.overview: Bo-bae impresses with her writing skills, but seeing Bo-bae and Eun-ho's bond up close ignites jealous sparks within Ho-rang. Eun-ho makes a bold move.

videos.title: Episodio 7
videos.overview: Worried about endangering yet another person she cares about, Bo-bae keeps her distance from Ho-rang. Do-yoon and Seol-hee's schemes come to a head.

videos.title: Episodio 8
videos.overview: Bo-bae and Ho-rang finally start dating. Ho-rang prepares for his succession announcement — but on the day of the event, Bo-bae is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Episodio 9
videos.overview: Ho-rang's collapse puts him in serious danger — until Bo-bae arrives in the nick of time. But she soon finds out a dangerous truth about her powers.

videos.title: Episodio 10
videos.overview: When Bo-bae learns her powers may be gone, she wonders what it means for her — and her future with Ho-rang. Will her story have a happy ending after all?
